pro_course_detail.title: General English Course: Speaking, Pronunciation, Grammar, Listening, Reading and Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn practical language skills through lessons that cover important grammar, vocabulary and topics at your level to speak English confidently in daily life. 

I will give you homework activities that are based on what you learn in each lesson so that you can also learn and practise independently. In addition, we will spend 5 minutes at the start of every lesson reviewing content from the previous lesson so that you can work on mastering your new vocabulary and skills!

Speaking: Practise speaking for everyday communication in English and learn useful pronunciation tips.

Listening: Improve your understanding through speaking and listening activities with me and with audio/video materials.

Reading: Enhance your comprehension with diverse texts and exercises.

Writing: Develop your writing skills through targeted practice and feedback.

Please message me if you would like more specific details about what you will learn in this course. Higher levels will be available soon!

pro_course_detail.title: Enhancing English Communication: Skills for Confident Conversation and Interaction
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you feel like you need to improve your English communication skills but don't know how? These may be the classes for you.

I will provide you with a communication skills checklist, giving you the opportunity to identify and tell me which areas of communication you wish to work on. I will then create a course that is personalised to you - based on the areas of communication you want to improve and including activities to develop speaking and listening fluency. 

Some examples of communication skills we may work on together include:

- Using idioms and expressions
- Using a variety of synonyms
- Understanding how and when to use  a range of past, present and future verb tenses
- Forming questions correctly
- Applying correct word and sentence stress and using connected speech
- Using phrases which show active listening in conversations
- Navigating specific contexts - e.g. buying something in a shop, cafe or restaurant

pro_course_detail.title: Welcome to New Zealand!
pro_course_detail.description:
Have you recently arrived to New Zealand? Are you planning your move? This short course will help you navigate your new life in beautiful New Zealand. 

I’ll cover essential topics such as the New Zealand communication style and accent, cultural insights, local customs, practical tips for settling in, and tips to help you connect with your community. I'll show you some New Zealand music, and we’ll also explore some iconic cities around New Zealand. I’ll help you pronounce the city names, many of which are in Te Reo Māori, New Zealand’s native language.
